newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 1.029 bln stg more help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 1.029 bln stg more help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 1.029 bmillion stg of assistance at established interest rates.
It allotted 484 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before June 4 and 545 million stg in repos to June 4.
The Bank has now provided liquidity totalling 2.129 billion stg so far on Wednesday in response to a forecast money market shortage of 2.15 billion stg.
The Bank then provided 45 million stg to the discount houses via repo.
